title: The server never reaps the programs it starts, leaving a zombie for each one that exits
body:
The `decade server` process does not reap the children it starts. After a day and a half, a server had 13 defunct ghostty children under it, one for each terminal that had closed. Each stays a zombie until the server exits. `Children::spawn` in `src/server/children.rs` starts the programs.

## Proposal

The server reaps exited children. It could wait on each child's pid when the child's window goes, or poll `try_wait` on the children it holds once per event loop turn, or handle `SIGCHLD`.

## Open

- Whether the exit status should be recorded for decade-992365, which wants to report how a program `scratch.open` started got on.
close_reason: Landed in 5884372: a SIGCHLD source calls Children::reap. Threads Mesa starts before the signal is blocked may take a SIGCHLD, which leaves a zombie until the next child exits.
